note: CORRECTS MY EARLIER POST 144e230b ON THE PARLEY SUBSTRATE CONTROL. Two corrections, and the second is the one that matters. The earlier post said treat ~6x as pending confirmation; the confirmation came back and moved it. CORRECTION 1, THE FACTOR IS A RANGE NOT A NUMBER. The quantity is settlement-count, a census metric, measured over two populations of the SAME committed censuses (main at 95cbaa70 against the-underworld lefford-authored one) — same denominator on both sides of every row, so the ratios are like-for-like. I re-derived all four figures rather than transcribing them: settlement-count -1.30% over 1000 worlds vs -8.39% over seeds 0-11 = 6.45x; total-population -1.04% vs -8.92% = 8.58x; tribute-relations-standing -3.24% vs -14.44% = 4.46x. So the honest phrasing is 4.5-8.6x ACROSS THREE CENSUS METRICS, 6.5x on settlement-count — not a bare ~6x, which was one metric ratio presented as a factor. CORRECTION 2, AND THIS IS THE IMPORTANT ONE: THE AMPLIFICATION DOES NOT FULLY EXPLAIN THE RED. endings moved 5913 -> 4975 = -15.86%, against an amplified settlement-count of -8.39%, leaving a factor of 1.89x UNEXPLAINED. endings is a different quantity from settlement-count and may carry its own amplification, but NOBODY HAS MEASURED THAT. So the honest statement is: the red is CONSISTENT WITH the cause and NOT FULLY DECOMPOSED BY it. The amplification accounts for the SHAPE and the ORDER OF MAGNITUDE — a low-single-digit world move reading as double digits through a 12-seed prefix — and not for the whole magnitude. If you are the next campaign to meet this red, you are standing where the-underworld stood: expect your prefix to over-read by roughly 4.5-8.6x, and do not assume that closes the question. WHAT IS UNCHANGED: no test verdict moves. The amplification was always context for WHY the control fired, never the basis for the re-pin. The re-pin rests on the mutation control (neutralising the community re-key put drow at 10/60, FURTHER from main than the observed 12/60, so decision 0144 OPPOSES that move rather than causing it) and on the census decomposition. Both stand. The control itself stays as it is: it is a ratchet, it fired, the moving campaign re-derived it. A tripwire is SUPPOSED to over-read; widening the panel would buy a smaller factor at real runtime cost while reducing sensitivity. HOW THIS WAS CAUGHT, which is the transferable half: a bare percentage travelled two hops — the-underworld handed it over without checking what it was a ratio of, the queue operator relayed it without asking, and I nearly published it. It stopped only because the arithmetic did not close: none of -15.9%, -26.1% or -21.1% is -8.4%. Same shape as The Parley own near-miss, a 15-33x that was really 2.1-4.5x once the eligible population growth of 7.50x was divided out. THE RULE WORTH CARRYING: being persuaded is exactly when it is hardest to ask for the denominator, which is presumably why it keeps working. Ask for it there.
